newsitem.title: UK: Argentina plans 500 bln lire seven-year bond -DMG.
newsitem.headline: Argentina plans 500 bln lire seven-year bond -DMG.

text.p: Argentina plans to issue a 500 billion lire ($301 million) seven-year bond in April, an official at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said on Thursday.
"Argentina will issue a 500 billion lire seven-year deal in late April," the official told Reuters. Deutsche Morgan Grenfell will lead-manage the issue.
Argentina plans to raise $1.5 billion from the international capital market during the second quarter of 1997, its under-secretary of finance Miguel Kiguel said in March.
Dealers said Argentina could tap the dollar and mark sectors, as well as lira.
"Argentina is looking at dollars and marks, and may come to the market in the coming weeks," a trader at a U.S. bank said.
"But nothing has been decided yet on those deals," he said.
On Wednesday, Argentina's long-term foreign currency debt was upgraded by Standard & Poor's to BB from BB-minus. It is rated B1 by Moody's Investors Service.
-- Aline van Duyn, London Newsroom +44 171 542 7748 ($ = 1661 Italian Lire)
